message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charge(s). Facts: The defendant provided hotel rooms for others to consume methamphetamine (crystal meth). This is facilitating drug use. In Chinese criminal law, providing a place for drug consumption is an offense under "容留他人吸食毒品罪" (Crime of harboring others to use drugs). The statutory name is "容留他人吸食毒品". According to correction rule: output only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we output "容留他人吸食毒品". No other offenses. So final answer: [罪名]容留他人吸食毒品<eoa>.
